conventions.opKey: <model>:<OP_NAME>, model = docType without the 'bai/' prefix (work-breakdown-structure is 'wbs'), matching CatalogEntry.key in op-catalog.ts
conventions.args: Semantic (model-filled) fields that must match exactly. App-filled fields (new-id, timestamp, actor, DateTime) never appear.
conventions.ambiguousArgs: Semantic fields the model should fill but whose exact wording/value is inherently open; reference values only, EXCLUDED from exact match. Presence of required ones can still be checked.
conventions.refArgs: ref-id fields (OID/PHID/*Id) the model must choose from context.refCandidates (same dotted-path keys the envelope uses). Score separately from args.
conventions.argMatch: Optional per-field comparator overriding strict equality: 'ci' (trimmed, case-insensitive string), 'date' (compare YYYY-MM-DD prefix; zod requires an ISO datetime), 'unordered' (array as a set), 'ci-unordered' (both).
conventions.omittedOptional: Optional semantic fields absent from args and ambiguousArgs are expected to be omitted or null.
conventions.context: context.docType/model is the document the chat is scoped to. context.state is a partial, human-readable snapshot of what the app knows (enough for the reducer preconditions to hold). refCandidates entries are {id,label}.
